name: Camping 101: Fishing
objectiveText: Speak with Lee Brown near Goldshire to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.   Raise your fishing skill to 20  ( 1 )

comments.body: If you have this quest and are wondering where you find the fishing pole it is bought from the trade supplies vendor [npc=66] in goldshire. Also another tip is to pick up cooking from [npc=1430] in the goldshire inn and use the fish that you get from leveling up fishing to help level your cooking. You can get from level 1-50+ with the fish and the recipe is sold from the trade supplies vendor. Easy way to knock out both of these professions early.
